summary: Project asset tree listed. Select a texture asset_id in assets.tree.textures for a model_edit texture operation; see bridge/NEXUS_ASSETS_v1.md.

assets.guidance: Only project-owned texture IDs are callable from model_edit. Import more images using the Nexus local IMPORT TEXTURE ASSET picker.
